text.description_html:
Fusion RH-S8, Shaker Rose Robe Hook

The Shaker Trim Robe Hook is a great way to get those bathroom robes and towels off of the floor. It is easy to install and comes with all the installation screws. It is so easy to install, in fact, that it shouldn't be relegated to the bathroom alone. Put a few near the front door to hang purses and bags and hang some in the mud room for hats and winter coats. The rustic style is all the rage, and it is a great way to add an earthy feel to any room. Choose from medium bronze and oil rubbed bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-S8 Shaker Towel Bar, Fusion TR-S8 Shaker Towel Ring, and Fusion PH-S8 Shaker Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Sonoma Collection Shaker Robe Hook:

  • Mount Width: 2-1/2"
  • Mount Length: 4-1/4"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
